description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet, viewed logged-out in the Twitter mobile/web UI, thanking a Pensacola, Florida rally crowd and urging supporters to speak up and fight for change. Two attached photos show the arena rally: one of Trump waving to a crowd holding large green-and-red letters spelling CHRISTMAS and Trump Pence signs above a red banner reading THANK YOU PENSACOLA, FLORIDA!, and one of the packed arena audience. Consistent with the December 2017 Pensacola rally; no date/timestamp is visible in the screenshot.
text: Tweet. Log in. Sign up. Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. This is your land, this is your home, and it's your voice that matters the most. So speak up, be heard, and fight, fight, fight for the change you've been waiting for your entire life!. MERRY CHRISTMAS and THANK YOU Pensacola, Florida!. CHRISTMAS. TRUMP PENCE. THANK YOU PENSACOLA, FLORIDA!
flags: No visible timestamp; rally date inferred, not shown in image

The embedded photo shows the blue-and-white striped, gold-domed temple-like structure on Little St. James Island, flanked by palm trees, with gold owl/bird statues at its corners. The post ends replying to >>147 with 'Normal? Q'. The paragraph's allegations are the post's claims, not verified fact.
